referents.why: Third masculine plural 'they' whose subject is the 'rod and staff' named in the clause before. The composite is the only plural candidate; masculine plural is the usual agreement for a masculine and a feminine noun together.
First person 'me' in 'they comfort me': the psalm's voice.

links.why: The opening gam ki (even though) makes cl0 the concession and cl1 the claim that holds anyway: 'I will fear no evil, even though I walk through the valley'.
The builder's label 'conceded' is not in link_types; the same relation is recorded above as the though link.
The ki after the main clause gives the reason: 'for you are with me'.

groups.why: The gam ki clause is the obstacle, the fearless claim holds anyway, and the ki clause gives its ground. The group names no referent of its own; the divine referent sits in the slots.

none_fit.what: 'your rod and your staff, they comfort me': a noun phrase set first as topic and serving as the subject of the verb after it. No link type relates a topic noun phrase to the clause it is the subject of; the 'they' slot carries the connection to the composite.
